scripts.text:
[Li]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Dokebis?
scripts.translation:
[李]
你獵殺夠50只土人了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Li]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[李]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Li]
Remember, I need help hunting Dokebis so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[李]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺土人，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Li]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[李]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Li]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[李]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

My fortune teller business needs a good supply of ^FF0000Dokebi Horns^000000 to give my customers good luck.

scripts.text: What did you need?

scripts.text:

Thank you for the horns.

scripts.text:

^FF000050 Dokebi Horns^000000, I can give you some good luck.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Li]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Dokebis.
How many would you like to hunt?
